per_query.question: Zeige den Umsatz nach Rabatt je Kundensegment.
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.company_name, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue, od.discount
FROM public.order_details od
JOIN public.orders o ON od.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN public.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name, od.discount
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT cd.customer_type_id,
       cd.customer_desc,
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM public.customer_demographics cd
JOIN public.customer_customer_demo ccd ON ccd.customer_type_id = cd.customer_type_id
JOIN public.customers c ON c.customer_id = ccd.customer_id
JOIN public.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY cd.customer_type_id, cd.customer_desc
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, cd.customer_type_id

per_query.question: Zeige pro Monat die Anzahl der Auftraege und der verspaeteten Auslieferungen.
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS monat, 
    COUNT(order_id) AS anzahl_auftraege,
    SUM(CASE WHEN shipped_date > required_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS verspaetete_auslieferungen
FROM 
    public.orders
GROUP BY 
    monat
ORDER BY 
    monat;
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date AS month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_created,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE o.shipped_date > o.required_date) AS late_orders
FROM public.orders o
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date
ORDER BY month

per_query.question: Wie verhalten sich Nachfrage und Lieferverzug im Monatsverlauf?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS month, 
    COUNT(order_id) AS total_orders,
    AVG(shipped_date - required_date) AS avg_delivery_delay
FROM 
    public.orders
WHERE 
    order_date IS NOT NULL AND shipped_date IS NOT NULL AND required_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    month
ORDER BY 
    month;
